content.what_it_is: MATLAB script (OSU runup benchmark, BM2) comparing modeled velocity against ADV measurements at stations A and B. Sets subsample stride sk=2 and velocity factor fact=1 (L3-4); configures figure size in inches (L6). Time alignment: loads model free-surface FSE_BM2_shi_tvd.txt (L8; t column 1, eta columns 2:n, L11-12) and measured WG1.txt (L14); finds the time of maximum of model eta column 1 (L16-22, num_t_shift) and of measured WG column 2 (L24-30, exp_t_shift); shifts model time t=t-num_t_shift+exp_t_shift-0.25 (L32; comment 'some difference between eta and u'). ADV A: loads model VT_A_BM2_shi_tvd.txt (L35), pads into vel(m,6) (L38-39), loads measured U_Velocity_AverageA.txt (L40); subplot 211 (L42) plots measured (every sk-th sample, demeaned by mean of first 25 samples, L43) vs model vel(:,1)/fact dashed (L46); axis [0 47 -2.0 3.5] (L49). ADV B: same loads for VT_B_BM2_shi_tvd.txt and U_Velocity_AverageB.txt (L51-56); the 'ADV A' text and legend are placed after the B data load (L57-58); subplot 212 (L60) plots measured B (L62) vs model with an extra -0.25 s shift (L65), text 'ADV B' (L68), axis (L69), xlabel Time (L70). No writes.
entities: script variables: sk @L3, fact @L4, datae @L8, m,n @L10, t @L11, eta @L12, WGdata @L14, k @L16/L24, num_shift_ind @L18, num_t_shift @L19, exp_shift_ind @L26, exp_t_shift @L27, data @L35/L51, nn @L36/L52, n @L37/L53, vel @L38-39/L54-55, veldata @L40/L56

equations.expr: t=t-num_t_shift+exp_t_shift-0.25; % some difference between eta and u

equations.ref: velocity columns into padded array (also L55)
measured U, demeaned by first 25 samples (also L62)
model U at ADV B with extra -0.25 s shift

calls: clf @L1; clear all @L2; set(gcf,...) @L6; load @L8, @L14, @L35, @L40, @L51, @L56; size @L10, @L36, @L52; max @L17, @L25; zeros @L38, @L54; subplot @L42, @L60; plot @L43, @L46, @L62, @L65; hold on @L45, @L64; ylabel @L47, @L67; grid @L48, @L66; axis @L49, @L69; text @L57, @L68; legend @L58; xlabel @L70

verbatim_spans.text: t=t-num_t_shift+exp_t_shift-0.25; % some difference between eta and u

unresolved: The ADV B model curve gets an additional -0.25 s shift (L65) on top of the global -0.25 s in L32, while ADV A uses the global shift only (L46) -- total shifts differ between panels without in-file justification.

text('ADV A') and legend are issued at L57-58 after the B-station data have replaced data/vel/veldata (L51-56) but before subplot(212); they still target the first axes only because subplot(212) is created at L60 -- fragile ordering.

n is set to 6 at L37/L53 overwriting the column count from size (L10), and vel is padded to 6 columns though only column 1 is plotted; m from L36/L52 overwrites the FSE record length; num_shift_ind/exp_shift_ind (L18, L26) unused.
Peak alignment uses eta column 1 of the model FSE file vs column 2 of WG1.txt (L17 vs L25); which gauge model column 1 corresponds to is not stated in this file.
Demeaning by mean(veldata(1:25,2)) (L43, L62) assumes the first 25 samples are still water; sampling rates of the measured files are not stated.
